prose: Apple introduced HomeView, a smart home hub with a 7-inch Liquid Retina display powered by Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. It brings music, FaceTime, home monitoring and hands-free automation together, and recognizes users by their face so each person can reach their own content in Messages and other apps. Privacy and security are stressed throughout. Basis: the opening of Apple's newsroom post via Daring Fireball.
highlights: HomeView: 7-inch display smart home hub with Siri AI.
Recognizes users by face to show personal content.
Covers music, FaceTime, monitoring and voice automation.
